fields.description: Issue includes editorials and reporting on Miami and Florida public affairs, including advocacy for state acquisition/public ownership of Florida Power & Light Company and discussion of Florida taxation and state finances. Prominent local coverage focuses on Miami police department controversy involving Detective Lieut. C. O. Huttoe, city commission actions, and calls for grand jury investigation. Additional items address a disputed taxi incident involving hotel manager Peter Niles, a reported mysterious death of a Jackson Memorial Hospital nurse, federal regulation affecting refills of sleeping-pill prescriptions, Greater Miami parks and playgrounds expansion funding, and notes on Florida oil developments; the issue also contains letters to the editor, local briefs, and advertisements.
